changes: Original HTML/CSS/JS are bundled inline for a no-same-origin sandbox. Restrictive CSP blocks external connections, frames and media.
Remote YouTube playback and static GIF are removed. Original channel controls and OSD run; an explicit disabled-playback note replaces video. No live playback is claimed.
Sandbox keyboard correction: Escape posts only the priyam-demo-close intent to the parent. The parent must verify event.source against the active iframe before closing.
Mobile-only compatibility CSS at 600px and below preserves desktop styling while fitting the original controls and content within a phone viewport.
Publishing normalization: trailing whitespace removed; final newline normalized. No logic or layout change.
